title: [Flight] Let encodeFormAction reuse the default encoding
author: dai-shi
body_preview: ## Summary  This is a follow-up to #27563.  The SSR Flight client's `encodeFormAction` callback fully replaces React's default form action encoding. title: Perf: non-leaf navigation in deeply-nested route trees re-matches every deeper sibling branch (super-linear, parabolic in depth)
author: greydragon888
body_preview: ## Summary  When the route tree is deeply nested, navigating to a **non-deepest** route makes `matchRoutes` try (and fail) every route branch that is *deeper* than the target before it reaches the matching branch.
